metadata.title: Boiled Laisak | Boiled Mustard Greens
metadata.description:
Click to tweet and share this recipe: http://ctt.ec/sq12d

Delicious, wholesome and simple plain boiled Mustard greens are easy to cook, taste really good and are really healthy. Mustard greens have an assertive and spicy flavor and in this dish is cooked boiling with little onion, chilies and ginger.
